learning.why: The football coach-referee analogy made the independence of judiciary from government salaries click.

end.summary:
Reviewed the structure of district courts, High Courts and the Supreme Court, including appeals.
Distinguished civil and criminal cases using everyday examples.
Discussed judicial review and judicial independence; Vihaan later used a referee analogy.
Introduced Lok Adalat, but its process and access to justice were not yet explained fully.
Teach-back did not pass.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised arranging the courts from district court to High Court to Supreme Court and explaining an appeal, then classified civil and criminal examples accurately. Judicial independence was first mixed up, but they later corrected it using the referee analogy and said a judge follows the Constitution rather than government preference. Lok Adalat, free legal aid and PIL need another short, example-based review. At home, discuss one simple dispute-resolution example and ask Vihaan to explain how Lok Adalat could help.

Ohhh, matlab referee jaise... coach paisa deta hai par referee rules dekhta hai, waise hi judge Samvidhaan dekhta hai, sarkaar nahi. Toh judge Samvidhaan ke hisaab se faisla karega. Sahi hai? Par yeh board pe kuch likha hai '≠' - iska matlab 'not equal' hai na? Dikhao thoda clear karke!

Haan, us nishaan ka matlab ‘barabar nahi’ hai. Aapne referee wali baat pakdi: judge faisla Samvidhaan dekhkar karta hai, sarkaar ke kehne par nahi. Board par ab seedhe shabdon mein likh deti hoon. Agar sarkaar ko judge ka faisla pasand na aaye, kya woh sirf is wajah se judge ko hata sakti hai?

Nahi, nahi hata sakti na, kyunki judge referee jaisa hai - tankhwah sarkaar ki par rule Samvidhaan ka. Par yeh likha hua 'Na-pasand faisla: judge ko hatana?' sahi se dikh nahi raha, thoda bada likho na!

Aapne kaha ki sirf na-pasand faisle par sarkaar judge ko nahi hata sakti; yahi judge ki azaadi ka point hai. Chhota likha tha, ab kam shabdon mein saaf likhti hoon. Ab aam logon ke liye insaaf ka ek raasta dekhein: Lok Adalat kya hoti hai?
Lok Adalat? Pata nahi... lok matlab log, Adalat matlab court, toh logon ki court? Par aise hoti kya hai, mujhe nahi pata. Photo dikhao na iski, ya kuch example do - kya karte hain ismein?

Haan, ‘adalat’ wala andaaza sahi hai; Lok Adalat mein log apna jhagda baatcheet se suljhane ki koshish karte hain. Photo abhi nahi dikha sakti, par example dekhiye: kisi dukaan se kharab saamaan mila aur dukaanwale ne paise lautane par sahmati de di. Dono ki sahmati se baat sulajh gayi. Is example mein jhagda kaise suljha?

Jhagda... woh dono ne aapas mein baat ki na, dukaanwale ne maan liya ki saamaan kharab tha, isliye paise de diye. Toh baatcheet se suljha. Par yeh Lok Adalat mein toh... judge hota hai na? Photo kyun nahi dikh rahi, dikhao na!

Haan, aapne sahi bataya ki dukaanwala aur grahak baatcheet se raazi hue. Lok Adalat mein judge ya doosre sadasya baat suljhane mein madad karte hain; woh aam trial ki tarah ek taraf par faisla nahi thopte. Photo abhi bana nahi sakti, isliye bada aur saaf dikhati hoon. Ab apne shabdon mein bataiye, Lok Adalat mein jhagda kaise sulajhta hai?
